title: Proposal: working together on LZTR1-related disorders research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into LZTR1-related disorders.
We are writing to the RASopathies Network because you support families affected by RASopathies, including LZTR1-related Noonan syndrome.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
Published work links LZTR1-related disorders to loss of function.
Relevant registries include the PATRAS registry in Europe and your own contact registry.
A clinical and genetic study of RASopathies is recruiting, and the Baby MERIT phase 3 MEK inhibitor trial, not yet recruiting, admits people with LZTR1 changes.
Other Noonan syndrome studies enrol by syndrome and their records do not name LZTR1.
A contested point: trametinib has no completed randomised trial yet, and authors call for dedicated trials.
Links to schwannomatosis groups are inferred by the atlas rather than stated by those groups.
We would propose a study on [research question about LZTR1-related disorders], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your contact registry or community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
